question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right midfielder, Bob is playing goalkeeper, Claire is playing left midfielder, Dave is playing right back, and Eve is playing striker.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Eve and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Then, Dave and Alice trade positions. Finally, Alice and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) right midfielder
(B) goalkeeper
(C) left midfielder
(D) right back
(E) striker
solution:
Each row lists positions in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: right midfielder | goalkeeper | left midfielder | right back | striker
1. Eve and Alice swap: striker | goalkeeper | left midfielder | right back | right midfielder
2. Claire and Bob swap: striker | left midfielder | goalkeeper | right back | right midfielder
3. Bob and Eve swap: striker | right midfielder | goalkeeper | right back | left midfielder
4. Dave and Alice swap: right back | right midfielder | goalkeeper | striker | left midfielder
5. Alice and Claire swap: goalkeeper | right midfielder | right back | striker | left midfielder
Alice is the goalkeeper, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
